Settings.EnterApiKey: Please enter an API key first
Settings.ApiKeyHint: Stored securely and used for ElevenLabs Scribe transcription.
Settings.ModelHint: Scribe v2 is used for file transcription; live dictation uses Scribe v2 Realtime.
Settings.TranscriptionModeHint: Automatic uses realtime when possible. REST only avoids realtime concurrency limits and always uses batch transcription.
Settings.TagAudioEvents: Include audio events such as [coughs] and [mouse clicks]
Settings.NoVerbatim: Clean up filler words and verbal stumbles
Settings.TranscriptCleanupHint: Audio events and transcript cleanup can both be enabled. ElevenLabs decides which annotations remain in that combination.
Settings.RestOnlyOptionsHint: Audio events and speaker count apply to REST requests only. Transcript cleanup also applies to realtime.
Settings.DictionaryTermsHint: Using dictionary terms routes this dictation through REST, supports up to 1,000 valid terms, and adds 20% to the ElevenLabs transcription cost.
